# Turn a year of bank transactions into Schedule C lines.

> Free tool for freelancers and sole proprietors: drop in your bank or card CSV and get income and expenses sorted into Schedule C lines, with estimated tax, equipment, health insurance and transfers held out, meals at 50%, a payment-platform payout warning and a CSV to hand your preparer.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
